summary: Fractal web reports the browser's raw presence state from one tab: active while any tab is visible and focused, inactive otherwise, with the newest input of any tab

schema.detail: No database, claim or client API change; the app uses the existing client-v0 availability operations.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. One tab per browser, the holder of a Web Lock, reports to POST /v1/client/presence on each change of the browser's state and again at the answer's report_again_at; no idle threshold and no heartbeat.

compatibility.detail: Reports start only when the capabilities grant write.presence to a person session, so other pairings and sessions report nothing; a daemon without POST /v1/client/presence (404) stops the reports, and a replay reports nothing.

recovery.detail: A device's state stops counting 24 hours after it was observed; set a status override to ignore presence.
